The button has data-browser-comment-submit. The popup callback sends browser-sidebar-comment-overlay-submit with browserTabId, conversationId, sessionId, body, attachedImages, designChange and conditional cropScreenshotToRegion/submitDirectly. The UI uses the current sessionId to suppress duplicate submission.

Renderer bridge sendMessageFromView invokes codex_desktop:message-from-view. Main dispatches editor submission to BrowserHostManager.handleCommentOverlaySubmit and ECe.handleOverlaySubmit. Browser page runtime messages use ipcRenderer.invoke(codex_desktop:browser-sidebar-runtime-message); main parses _Ce and resolves the sender BrowserWindow/context before dispatch.

handleOverlaySubmit validates current overlay sessionId and thread state. Create/design save builds a comment (id, createdAt, body, anchor, viewportSize), writes it to threadState.snapshot.comments, dismisses editor, synchronizes comment snapshot, then awaits captureSavedCommentScreenshot.

Shared batch flow has default saved submission and persistent=true; quick flow has default direct and persistent=false. A new nonpersistent comment resets interactionMode to browse through BR; persistent batch save retains comment mode. Screenshot mode can render the target even while interaction mode is browse.

ECe.dismiss calls aCe.dismiss plus closeRuntimeEditor. aCe.dismiss marks overlay not visible and UU hides the popup BrowserWindow. closeRuntimeEditor sends close-editor; the preload clears editor/hover/draft/screenshot state using React flushSync.

captureSavedCommentScreenshot sends prepare-comment-screenshot(commentId) to the same page webContents. Preload qy sets screenshot state D. It selects that saved annotation, resolves live target geometry, and schedules ready using one requestAnimationFrame from a React effect; ready reports annotationViewportRect and markerViewportPoint, plus conditional skipScreenshotCapture.

During open editing, visualViewport/window/frame resize and scroll trigger new anchor calculation and runtime-update-anchor. X_ resolves saved element targets again in screenshot mode; $u prefers a connected cached element, then selector lookup on the same URL and frame, filtering live candidates and matching name/nearby text. Geometry uses getBoundingClientRect plus frame offset.

The screenshot-ready annotation rectangle is the union of current selected highlight/text/additional rectangles. Marker point is the rendered marker position divided by browser zoom factor P. captureBrowserScreenshot prefers ready geometry over the originally saved geometry.

captureBrowserScreenshot calls await pageWebContents.capturePage() with zero arguments. It supplies no Electron capture rectangle/options, does not load a new page, and does not create a DOM rasterization surface in this path. NativeImage crop/resize happen after the visible page surface capture.

Default capture is full visible page. A single non-element target can request region cropping when screenshot preference is necessary. A single-anchor non-edit comment at ordinal >=10 selects compact capture. Crop target unions target rectangle with a marker-sized rectangle.

Source constants: readiness timeout=1000ms, normal crop padding=32 CSS units, compact padding=16 CSS units; maximum long edge full viewport=1280, normal crop=1024, compact=768. At >=10 saved comments existing eligible screenshots are compacted; multi-anchor screenshots are skipped by that compactor.

lW maps viewport crop to image pixel coordinates using imageWidth/viewportWidth and imageHeight/viewportHeight independently; floor for start, ceil for end, clamp to image boundaries. The screenshot pipeline does not read or hardcode devicePixelRatio. Browser overlay CSS applies inverse browser-zoom scaling. Main cropping therefore accounts for actual captured surface dimensions rather than multiplying an assumed DPR. The viewportSize denominator comes from the stored annotation; ready does not return a new viewportSize. A viewport resize between save and capture can therefore require an explicit current-size check in a different product implementation.

yW stores NativeImage.toDataURL(), width, height, annotationViewportRect, markerViewportPoint and conditional cropViewportRect, cropPaddingPx, isCompact. There is no explicit MIME/quality argument, separate MIME field, byte length, capture latency or screenshot capturedAt in this helper. createdAt belongs to comment creation in xW. PNG interpretation relies on Electron nativeImage.toDataURL API behavior; no real image was captured in this read-only research.

A readiness waiter is a single entry keyed by webContents.id with commentId; starting another resolves the previous waiter(null). Ready resolves only matching webContents.id/commentId. Saved capture looks up commentId before capture and maps screenshot onto that id afterward; deletion is not undone. This saved method does not compare generation/content revision or revalidate page/tab/conversation ownership after capture.

Direct submission captures first, then validates owner not destroyed, same page object/webContents/browserTabId/conversationId, and same thread state. It sends the comment only when these still match. If image is absent and ownership remains valid it sends textual comment without screenshot.

Missing/destroyed page returns without image; ready timeout or skipScreenshotCapture returns without image; capture exception reports a nonfatal error and returns undefined. Saved text/anchor already in snapshot remain. finally clears screenshot UI state when page remains alive. Element disappearance can cause skipScreenshotCapture; exact renderer predicate depends on all element targets failing live resolution.
Ordinary edit submission updates body/attachedImages/designChange, dismisses and synchronizes; it does not call captureSavedCommentScreenshot again and retains existing screenshot.

Committed navigation to a different normalized URL invokes dismissForCommittedNavigation during comment mode. Certain pending or virtual/unlocated saved edits preserve editor fallback. URL normalization ignores hash for http/file comparisons. closePage requests thread teardown and invalidates page routing; it does not itself provide an explicit screenshot generation guard.

Capture uses the live user page surface after editor dismissal and readiness frame. This path does not freeze media/animations or provide a transaction tying comment createdAt, DOM geometry, and captured pixels to one moment. Latest ready geometry and crop surface can be separated by async time. Screenshot-ready geometry is stored on screenshot metadata; the saved comment anchor is not replaced with that later live anchor in captureSavedCommentScreenshot.
